title: Audit odds provider mapping and snapshot persistence

audit_window.reason: The 30-day window confirms that the zero-snapshot condition is persistent rather than a single-day outage.

runtime_stage_counts.unobservable_reason: The scheduler log exposes only target count, post-ingestion match count and snapshots; raw provider rows and first-stage mapping counts are not persisted.

pipeline_trace.finding: Raw /events and /odds/multi row counts are not persisted; no unexpired event cache remained in Redis.
Mapping is recomputed in memory from team names and kickoff. No provider-fixture mapping table exists. The first provider-side pass omits configured team aliases.
The aggregate loss combines provider data absence, first-stage mapping misses and parser omissions; current telemetry cannot separate them.
Confirmed code defect: OddsApiIoProvider translates ML to market='1x2', while OddsIngestionService accepts only market='h2h'. The skip does not increment outcomes_skipped.

Not reached after the market-key mismatch. A latent risk remains because only market.updatedAt is parsed and missing timestamps are rejected. Verification requires a separately approved controlled API probe.
Production bookmakers=0 proves no matched market reached get-or-create bookmaker.
Repository uses ON CONFLICT natural-key idempotency and the service transaction commits on success. No post-creation persistence loss is evidenced.
Retrieval returns no rows because the table is globally empty; no retrieval or timezone defect can be demonstrated from production data.
All 15 eligible candidates in TASK-20260828-024 stopped at odds availability, before EV, Kelly, confidence or RecommendationGate qualification.

confirmed_findings.finding: Market vocabulary mismatch: provider emits 1x2, ingestion accepts h2h, causing 100% silent loss after successful fixture matching.
Bet365-only produces at most one bookmaker per selection, while VerifiedMarketQuotePolicy requires at least two; VERIFIED is mathematically impossible.
Targeted production get_odds_for_fixtures bypasses The Odds API fallback. API-Football is not an odds provider.
No persistent provider-event mapping exists; the first mapping pass does not use configured team aliases, and raw response/mapping counts are not retained.
NO_ODDS_TRUE/no_snapshots accurately reports the database state but collapses provider absence, mapping failure, market mismatch and timestamp rejection.
Bookmaker external_source and prediction provider_sources are hardcoded as the-odds-api even when Odds-API.io is the actual primary.

not_supported_by_evidence.note: These cannot explain current production because no bookmaker or snapshot row has ever been created.

code_pr_scope: Canonicalize Odds-API.io ML to the ingestion contract market key h2h.
Add a provider-to-ingestion end-to-end unit test proving three Bet365 snapshots are attempted and natural-key idempotency is preserved.
Expose structured counters for raw rows, first mapping, parsed markets, market-key rejects, missing timestamps, created and existing snapshots.
Address targeted primary/fallback behavior explicitly; do not silently query a directory-level fallback outside approved fixture IDs.
recommended_follow_up.configuration_decision: Under the paid plan, enable and validate at least one additional permitted bookmaker while retaining minimum_bookmakers=2. Do not lower the verification rule in order to create recommendations.
recommended_follow_up.controlled_api_probe_scope: One approved fixture, one /events request and one /odds/multi request to verify actual market timestamp location, bookmaker key spelling and event/team fields; redact the API key.
recommended_follow_up.snapshot_backfill_note: Do not fabricate historical capture timestamps. After the fix and probe, perform only a separately approved bounded refresh for currently eligible T-90/T-60/T-30 fixtures.

approval_gate: STOP; no fix implemented. Separate code/config/probe approvals are required.
